messages:
maria_cs: Heads up — Bluecrest Logistics is ramping localization across 3 new squads. Seeing embed/API qps up ~6x this week. Opening thread to coordinate onboarding, capacity, and renewal signal. cc @alex_ae @jake_se @sophie_ts

alex_ae: Noted. Renewal in ~6 months — this looks like a good expansion -> reduce churn opportunity. Can we get rough $ impact and any SSO/KMS asks?

jake_se: Quick q: do we have exact QPS and token profiles? Are they moving from Hosted -> Dedicated or still testing?

maria_cs: From our check-in: currently on Hosted, started a Dedicated POC for throughput. Measured p95 latency ~220ms. QPS: avg 180 -> peaks ~1.1k. Token distribution skewed to short prompts (~20t) but nightly embedding batches spike. Current config has batching on. Logs/metrics snapshot:

```
peak_qps: 1100
avg_tokens_per_request: 45
workload: embedding-batch + chat endpoints
window: 01:00-03:00 UTC
```

deploy_bot: autoscale alert — Bluecrest hosted pool GPU saturation at 03:12 UTC, throttle applied :warning:

jake_se: Ok — recommend Dedicated pilot with burst capacity + KV prefix caching. Baseline estimate: 2x A100-class GPUs, burst to 4 during nightly window. I'll draft a pilot config and cost sketch.

sophie_ts: I'll own enablement: 1h workshop for their infra + app teams. Need SAML details and sample batch payloads to prep slides.

maria_cs: Sample payload (simple): `[{doc_id: "123", text: "..."}, {doc_id: "124", text: "..."}]` — sending onboarding playbook link to ticket: https://redwood.internal/cs/runbooks/bluecrest-onboard (internal).

alex_ae: I'll flag finance — if they convert to Dedicated we can offer reserved discount and move renewal conversation earlier. Capture success metrics too: p95 <250ms, cost per 1k tokens target. I'll follow up with ACV impact.

jake_se: Also add instrumentation: cache_hit_ratio, avg_batch_size, tail_latency. KV cache should reduce tokens/cost for short prompts.

sophie_ts: :thumbsup: Scheduling workshop Wed 16:00 PT. Invite sent. @maria_cs can you confirm attendee list (PM, infra, analytics)?

maria_cs: Done — PM, infra lead, analytics lead included. One ask from customer: private deployment for data compliance. Escalating to security/private-deploy team.

alex_ae: For compliance ask I'll loop in security & solutions. For now let's get pilot config + cost estimates ready. Thanks all — will update the renewal risk/opp in CRM.
